answer: Ghost skippers reserved unpaid quay slots with copied draft marks. A berth clears only after the claimant seats a 9-kg marble datum block on bollard 4, brushes a 14-mm violet keel stripe at waterline, and posts the 40-byte hash of a 20-second harbor laser shot from 42 m, locking 26 POA for 6 epochs. Four clerks rebuild the point cloud in 0.8 s and must read the same stripe length within 3 mm. One key may seat 1 block per epoch, so 47 aliases lock 1,222 POA. A reused block serial, or two shots agreeing on 17 of 20 seconds, burns 15 POA and bars that key for 5 epochs.
